7:34pm: A convincing consolation win for Bangladesh to end the series. Afghanistan 
didn't show up with the bat but Farooqi's new-ball strikes gave some hope. But Litton 
stood tall and Shakib was proactive from the get go. He took the hosts from 28 for 2 
after 7 overs to 89 for 3 off 17, his innings and the partnership went at a run a ball. 
Hridoy was busy at the crease and completed the win. Afghanistan's debutants got a 
bowl but there wasn't much to defend. Abdul Rahman's pace and Zia-ur-Rehman's 
ability to turn the ball were positives. But Shoriful's piercing spell and Litton's return-to-
form fifty shone today. 
Presentations coming up. 
Shoriful Islam, POTM: Thanks to almighty. Says he's worked hard to come to this point. 
After the Ireland games, Hathurasinghe and Donald gave me some things to work on 
and I did that. When the bowling partnership goes well, the rhythm also improves. 
Taskin was also bowling very well which made it easier for me. 
Fazalhaq Farooqi, POTS: Congratulations to everyone back. I struggled in the Sri Lanka 
series and we had a good prep camp. The problem in Sri Lanka was that I wasn't 
bowling in the right areas, I did that here and found success. 
Litton Das, Bangladesh captain: Before the T20I series, this win helps the boys. They did 
a good job. Shoriful and Taskin used the new ball well, the spinners bowled well in the 
middle overs as well. All credit to the bowlers. Definitely confident going into the T20Is. 
Hashmatullah Shahidi, Afghanistan captain: Very happy with the series performance. 
Tough for us today, we were not complacent and will learn from the loss. Bangladesh 
played well, put us under pressure right from the beginning. I won't be part of the T20 
squads, my best wishes for the players going in. Special thanks to the Afghanistan fans, 
They support us everywhere we go. 
Hashmat goes to collect the trophy as Afghanistan have won the series 2-1. He poses 
with a wide smile and then goes to the banner reading WINNER, he hands the trophy 
and goes to the side as cheers go up. More photos being taken of the players, the 
Afghan fans look thrilled too. Remember, it's the first time Afghanistan have won a 
series against Bangladesh. 
That's the end of the second leg in Afghanistan's two-part tour to Bangladesh. They've 
come back strongly in the ODIs after being trounced in the Test. The first of the two 
T20Is will be on the 14th. See you then. Thanks for tuning in. Goodbye from me, Ekanth, 
my co-commentator, Abhimanyu Bose, and our scorer, Harshith Gowda.
